内容的多样性和丰富性，一般来说，一个主题确定后，通过接触和这个主题相关的多个方面的学习内容，加速学生对新内容的内化和理解，进而深入探究，培养学生的创造能力。"教程"为了联系学生的实际，开阔学生的视野，从四级分册开始以主题引领，每个主题下又分为若干小主题，主题之间相互联系形成有机的知识网络，使之牢固地镶嵌在学生的记忆深处，不易遗忘。 (Nèiróng de duōyàngxìng hé fēngfùxìng, yībān lái shuō, yī gè zhǔtí quèdìng hòu, tōngguò jiēchù hé zhège zhǔtí xiāngguān de duō gè fāngmiàn de xuéxí nèiróng, jiāsù xuéshēng duì xīn nèiróng de nèihuà hé lǐjiě, jìn'ér shēnrù tànjiū, péiyǎng xuéshēng de chuàngzào nénglì. "Jiàochéng" wèile liánxì xuéshēng de shíjì, kāikuò xuéshēng de shìyě, cóng sì jí fēncè kāishǐ yǐ zhǔtí yǐnlǐng, měi gè zhǔtí xià yòu fēnwéi ruògān xiǎo zhǔtí, zhǔtí zhījiān xiānghù liánxì xíngchéng yǒujī de zhīshì wǎngluò, shǐ zhī láogù de xiāngqiàn zài xuéshēng de jìyì shēnchù, bùyì yíwàng.) - Once a topic is fixed, exposure to multiple aspects of learning content related to it accelerates students' internalization and understanding of new content, leads to deeper exploration, and cultivates creative ability; starting from the fourth-level volumes the Course is led by themes, each divided into sub-themes, interconnected into an organic network of knowledge firmly embedded in students' memory.

这种设计遵循汉语国际教育的理念，注重教材的普适性、应用性和实用性，海内外教学机构可根据学时建议来设计每册书完成的年限。比如，一级的《教程1》规定用34学时完成，如果国内周课时是8课时的话，大概一个月左右就能学完；在海外如果一周是4课时的话，就需要两个月的时间能学完。以此类推。一般来说，学完《教程1》就能通过一级考试，同样学完《教程2》就能通过二级考试，等等。 (Zhè zhǒng shèjì zūnxún Hànyǔ guójì jiàoyù de lǐniàn, zhùzhòng jiàocái de pǔshìxìng, yìngyòngxìng hé shíyòngxìng, hǎinèiwài jiàoxué jīgòu kě gēnjù xuéshí jiànyì lái shèjì měi cè shū wánchéng de niánxiàn. Bǐrú, yī jí de "Jiàochéng 1" guīdìng yòng 34 xuéshí wánchéng, rúguǒ guónèi zhōu kèshí shì 8 kèshí dehuà, dàgài yī gè yuè zuǒyòu jiù néng xuéwán; zài hǎiwài rúguǒ yī zhōu shì 4 kèshí dehuà, jiù xūyào liǎng gè yuè de shíjiān néng xuéwán. Yǐ cǐ lèituī. Yībān lái shuō, xuéwán "Jiàochéng 1" jiù néng tōngguò yī jí kǎoshì, tóngyàng xuéwán "Jiàochéng 2" jiù néng tōngguò èr jí kǎoshì, děngděng.) - The design follows the philosophy of international Chinese education; institutions can set the completion time per volume from the recommended class hours. For example, Course 1 is designed for 34 class hours: about one month at 8 hours per week domestically, two months at 4 hours per week abroad. Generally, finishing Course 1 lets one pass the Level 1 exam, finishing Course 2 the Level 2 exam, and so on.

汉语水平考试（HSK）共分六个等级，"教程"编教人员仔细研读了"大纲"和出题指南，并对大量真题进行了统计、分析。根据真题统计结果归纳出每册的重点、难点、语言点、话题、功能、场景等，在遵循HSK大纲词汇要求的前提下，系统设计了各级别的范围、课时等，具体安排如下： (Hànyǔ Shuǐpíng Kǎoshì (HSK) gòng fēn liù gè děngjí, "jiàochéng" biānjiào rényuán zǐxì yándúle "dàgāng" hé chūtí zhǐnán, bìng duì dàliàng zhēntí jìnxíngle tǒngjì, fēnxī. Gēnjù zhēntí tǒngjì jiéguǒ guīnà chū měi cè de zhòngdiǎn, nándiǎn, yǔyándiǎn, huàtí, gōngnéng, chǎngjǐng děng, zài zūnxún HSK dàgāng cíhuì yāoqiú de qiántí xià, xìtǒng shèjìle gè jíbié de fànwéi, kèshí děng, jùtǐ ānpái rúxià:) - The HSK is divided into six levels; the editors studied the Syllabus and question-writing guidelines and statistically analysed many real exam questions, summarising each volume's key points, difficulties, language points, topics, functions and scenarios, and systematically designed the scope and class hours of each level within the HSK Syllabus vocabulary requirements, as follows:

为了使学习者适应HSK的考试题型，教材的各级练习册设计的练习题型均与HSK考试题型吻合，从练习的顺序到练习的结构等都与考题试卷保持一致，练习的内容以本课的内容为主，目的是学习者学完教材就能适应HSK考试，不需额外熟悉考试形式。 (Wèile shǐ xuéxízhě shìyìng HSK de kǎoshì tíxíng, jiàocái de gè jí liànxí cè shèjì de liànxí tíxíng jūn yǔ HSK kǎoshì tíxíng wěnhé, cóng liànxí de shùnxù dào liànxí de jiégòu děng dōu yǔ kǎotí shìjuàn bǎochí yīzhì, liànxí de nèiróng yǐ běn kè de nèiróng wéi zhǔ, mùdì shì xuéxízhě xuéwán jiàocái jiù néng shìyìng HSK kǎoshì, bù xū éwài shúxī kǎoshì xíngshì.) - So that learners adapt to the HSK question types, the workbook exercises at every level match the HSK question types in order and structure, with content based mainly on the lesson, so learners can adapt to the HSK exam after finishing the textbook without extra familiarization with the exam format.

findings: The HSK 1-3 network has 5379 nodes and 32076 links (mean degree 11.9, density 0.0022) and 100.0% of nodes lie in a single connected giant component.
Degrees are very uneven: the mean is 11.9 but the largest hub (char node '我 wǒ (character, I/me)') has 745 links, and k2/k = 72.6.

A discrete power law fits the tail above degree 8 with exponent alpha = 2.75, and clearly beats an exponential, but a likelihood-ratio test cannot separate the power law from a lognormal (p = 0.320962).

Average clustering is 0.164, about 79 times that of equal-size random graphs (0.0021), while the average path length of the giant component is 3.45 versus 3.73 for random graphs, so the network is small-world by sigma but not by omega (sigma = 85.8, omega = 0.84; diameter 8).

The most central node is '我 wǒ (character, I/me)' by degree and '的 (de) - attributive particle' by sampled betweenness; degree and PageRank agree closely (Spearman 0.97) and the innermost k-shell is 9 holding 1398 nodes.
Louvain finds 32 fine communities (Q = 0.38), merged into 8 major ones (Q = 0.36); 0 of the 8 are strong and 2 are weak, and the strongest keeps 36% of its links inside.

Major communities line up with the book structure: NMI is 0.39 against chapters and 0.10 against HSK level, and 39% of characters occur in two or more chapters (most widespread: '你 (nǐ) — you' in 50 chapters).

Removing 20% of nodes at random leaves 78% of the network in the giant component, but removing the top 20% by degree leaves 44% and by sampled betweenness 62%, so the network resists failure better than targeted attack.
